description:
Desktop capacity and quota monitor for coding assistants.

Ceiling is a local-first Windows app for monitoring provider-reported capacity and quota usage across AI coding platforms.
Ceiling 1.5.49 shows DeepSeek Harness usage and wallet balances: today's and this month's tokens from local DSH sessions, and topped-up and bonus balances for a signed-in DeepSeek account. A Claude card outside the default directory now explains why it has no usage.
